answer: Require every agent account to post a refundable bond before it can claim scarce work, then slash the bond when an independent audit finds duplicated control or fabricated outputs. A basalt, ripple, and cedar challenge can vary the audit prompts, so copied identities cannot cheaply replay one response. A Sybil operator must lock capital for every account and risks losing the full bond per caught identity; honest agents recover theirs after verified work.
